mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, user_id AS userId, title, content, image_path AS imagePath, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM post ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT post_id AS postId, user_id AS userId, title, content, image_path AS imagePath, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM post WHERE post_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, title, content, image_path, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imagePath}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title =#{title}, content = #{content}, image_path = #{imagePath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
